actions.desc: The yowler lets loose a horrid scream. Each hostile creature within 30 feet of the yowler that can hear it must succeed on a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the yowler's Yowl for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Yowl

traits.desc:
The yowler’s undead form is constantly covered with a magical illusion that makes it look like it did in life. This effect is suppressed for 1 minute if the yowler attacks or uses Yowl.

The changes wrought by this illusion fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the yowler’s fur appears soft and silky, but someone touching it would feel the yowler’s rotten fur and exposed bones. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern the yowler’s true appearance.

ru.description:
Маленький домашний кот мягко мурлычет и дёргает своим хвостом. Внезапно он выпускает леденящий кровь вопль, когда он выгибает свою спину. Иллюзия уступает место истинному существу: гниющему неживому коту со светящимися зелёными глазами, длинными зубами и когтями, как ножи.

Вопящие коты — неживые домашние животные и фамильяры со счётом, который нужно свести, и ненавистью к живым.
ru.name: Вопящий кот
